learning_outcomes.text: Turn a product idea into a clear, testable specification
Use Claude to refine the spec and surface edge cases
Translate the spec into a Figma design with defined states
Implement the frontend in Cursor against the spec and design
Operate the spec-to-frontend loop with review and traceability
